events.title: Out-of-favour 맨체스터 유나이티드 striker Peter Davenport becomes 미들즈브러's record signing in a £750,000 deal. Former 토트넘 홋스퍼 manager Keith Burkinshaw takes over as manager of Third Division strugglers 질링엄 .

In the Second Division, 첼시 win at league leaders 왓퍼드 through goals from Gordon Durie and Kerry Dixon , Tommy Tynan fires four for 플리머스 아가일 against 블랙번 로버스 , and John Sheridan scores the only goal as 리즈 유나이티드 pick up an away win at 입스위치 타운 . 노리치 시티 continue to head the First Division title race with a 2–0 win over 윔블던 at Plough Lane . 밀월 go second with a 3–1 home win over Luton. 토트넘 홋스퍼 are bottom after a 3–1 home defeat to 더비 카운티, which sees the East Midlanders bounce from 13th to sixth in the table. 맨체스터 유나이티드's frustrating form continues when they are held to a 1–1 draw at home to 애스턴 빌라, meaning that they have now drawn five out of 10 First Division games this season.
아스널 go second in the First Division with a 4–1 away over 노팅엄 포리스트. They are now 노리치 시티's nearest challengers, six points behind with a game in hand.
Ralph Milne , the 27-year-old winger with 브리스틀 시티 in the Third Division, makes a surprise £170,000 move to 맨체스터 유나이티드.

노리치 시티 are still top of the First Division but draw 1–1 at home to 셰필드 웬즈데이, with 아스널 winning 1–0 at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 to cut 노리치 시티's lead to four points. 사우샘프턴 go third win a 3–1 home win over 애스턴 빌라. 맨체스터 유나이티드 make it six draws from their first 11 games with a 2–2 stalemate away to 더비 카운티.
에버턴 striker Adrian Heath is sold to 에스파뇰 of Spain for £600,000.
맨체스터 유나이티드 sell winger Jesper Olsen to Bordeaux of France for £400,000, where he links up with former 토트넘 홋스퍼 striker Clive Allen .
옥스퍼드 유나이티드 captain Tommy Caton returns to the First Division in a £100,000 move to 찰턴 애슬레틱. 맨체스터 유나이티드 sell Danish winger Jesper Olsen to Bordeaux for £400,000.

The FA Cup first round kicks off with non-league Altrincham and Bognor Regis Town both seeing off Football League opposition. 노리치 시티 drop points again when they are held to a 1–1 draw at 에버턴, with 아스널 cutting the gap between first and second to two points with a 3–0 home win over 미들즈브러. A relegation crunch game at Kenilworth Road sees 루턴 타운 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 4–1. Bottom club 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 crash to a 4–0 defeat at 밀월. 포츠머스 go top of the Second Division, level on points with 왓퍼드 and 블랙번 로버스, with a 3–0 home win over 반즐리.

맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 draw at home to 셰필드 웬즈데이 in the First Division, and have now drawn eight of their opening 13 league games. 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 코번트리 시티 draw 1–1 in a stalemate at White Hart Lane . 리버풀 beat 아스널 2–1 in a League Cup third round replay at Villa Park .
윔블던 defender Terry Phelan is omitted from tomorrow's squad for the First Division fixture against 리버풀 due to a court appearance he faces on a charge of cannabis possession.

노리치 시티 are held to another draw, this time 2–2 at home to 루턴 타운, but retain their lead of the First Division. 아스널 lose 2–1 to 더비 카운티 at the Baseball Ground in a match where victory would have taken them to the top of the league on goal difference. 코번트리 시티 go fifth with a 2–1 home win over local rivals 애스턴 빌라. There are thrilling victories for two promotion-chasing teams in the Second Division, with 반즐리 beating 본머스 5–2 at Oakwell and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 beating 크리스털 팰리스 5–3 at the Hawthorns .

The only professional action of the day sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 grind out a goalless draw on Tyneside . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are still bottom of the First Division, having won just two of their first 14 games. 맨체스터 유나이티드 have so far lost just twice in the league, but nine draws and a mere three victories have left them rooted in mid table.

The month ends with 노리치 시티 still top of the First Division, with 아스널, 밀월, 리버풀, 코번트리 시티 and 사우샘프턴 all in close contention. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are level on points at the bottom. 왓퍼드 and 블랙번 로버스 lead the way in the Second Division, level on 33 points. 맨체스터 시티, 첼시, 포츠머스 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 occupy the play-off zone.
